title: Regime-aware PDE stabilization route transfer
scientific_goal: Select a stable, accurate and efficient numerical route for unseen convection, diffusion, wave and mixed PDE regimes.
research_object: Transfer of route-level error, oscillation, energy-drift and cost behavior across held-out physical families.

source_questions.research_goal: Obtain a compact low-dissipation convection-diffusion scheme without spurious oscillations.
Balance discontinuity stabilization against artificial dissipation.
source_questions.transferred_role: robust candidate route and dissipation trade-off

source_questions.research_goal: Preserve energy during long-time spectral wave integration.
source_questions.transferred_role: energy-preserving candidate route and drift response

evidence_roles.public_calibration: complete physical families with every route observed
evidence_roles.deployment: unseen cases inside the declared nondimensional domain
evidence_roles.hidden_reference: derived route outcomes for continuous scientific scoring

difficulty_hypothesis: A solver must discover a transferable regime representation and cannot obtain most scientific credit from schema compliance or a single global polynomial.
solvability_argument: Complete public families identify route behavior, and an independent coupled-regime implementation reaches full verifier credit.
